profile.subseg: **Shunts** (current sensing: auto, smart metering, BMS, energy mgmt) · **Thermostatic bimetals** · **Electric contacts** (relays, switchgear, smart meters) · **PCBA + busbar assemblies** (EV/electrification)

deepdive.sec: Precision components / **electrification & current-sensing** (adjacent to Power/Grid, not a transformer-component)

bull_bear.body:
- Silver/commodity price swings (revenue optics in contacts, limited margin effect).
- Americas softness; EV adoption "turbulence in between."
- Execution of the move to integrated assemblies (PCBA/busbar) — newer capability.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body:
- This is an **electrification + smart-metering + EV current-sensing** beneficiary, *not* a transformer-shortage name — different layer of the power value chain (slot it as an adjacency in the sector view).
- The real story is **mix-led margin expansion** (EBITDA +26% on rev +12%), not volume.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Shunts:** India strong — automotive, **smart metering**, current sensing, **BMS**, energy management.
- **Thermostatic bimetals:** Europe strong (local presence + export momentum).
- **Electric contacts:** big growth (general business + silver); new plant added capacity (was capacity-stressed); customers prefer Shivalik → set up quickly; relay/smart-meter demand.
- **Pune facility:** PCBA + **busbar assemblies** for automotive/electrification — integrated, application-ready solutions.
- Geography: India largest; **Europe = growth engine**; Asia broad momentum; **Americas soft** (normalizing).

latest_quarter.body: - Margin expansion from **value-add mix** (components/assemblies vs strip), operating leverage, cost discipline.
latest_quarter.title: Margins / mix

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q4/FY26 (this):** rev ₹570.9cr (+12%), EBITDA 22.9% (+250bps), PAT ₹95.8cr; shunt component mix 55→65%; contacts +60% (~half silver); Pune PCBA/busbar capability; Europe strong, Americas soft.
- _Q1 FY27 → check: contacts growth ex-silver, shunt realization, Pune assemblies ramp, Americas normalization._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- No hard numbers; FY27 priorities: **margin quality, working-capital efficiency, value-add components**, deeper OEM/Tier-1 partnerships.
- Contacts: expects growth "possibly more than" FY26 (deferred business now serviceable after new plant).
- Shunt realization keeps rising as component mix climbs.
outlook.title: Guidance / outlook

deepdive.thesis: A precision-engineering platform moving **strip → components → assemblies** (PCBA, busbars) for **current sensing, smart metering, EV/BMS and electrification**. FY26: rev +12% but **EBITDA +26% / margin 22.9% (+250bps)** — a deliberate value-add / mix-up story (shunt component mix 55→65% = +10–12% realization). NOT a transformer-component play; sits in the **adjacent electrification / smart-metering** layer of the broader power theme.
